purpose: Recover from the v2.3 protocol omission by recording MORPHO's structural HDF5 metadata before any final v2.4 mapping, schema eligibility decision, waveform-array access, scoring, cache construction, or confirmation run.

predecessor_invalidation.required_boundary: v2.3 is immutable and invalidated. Its source receipts are integrity history only; its COQTEL schema gate is not a reusable eligibility result.

allowed: raw-byte SHA-256 verification before HDF5 open
HDF5 object paths and object kinds
dataset shape, rank, dtype, chunks, and compression metadata
attribute names and HDF5 attribute dtype/shape metadata obtained through AttributeManager.get_id
forbidden: dataset indexing, slicing, conversion, or any H5Dread payload access
AttributeManager.__getitem__ or any attribute value materialization
reading a label, fatigue-block, time, health, degradation, or waveform value
selecting a mapping, declaring schema eligibility, computing a signal metric, training, scoring, caching, E9, or auditing a confirmation result

must_include: no schema eligibility decision and no mapping-selection receipt
